in_marathi.name: Eneeshay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eneeshay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eneeshay is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Surya’, which means sun. This name signifies being the lord or ruler of the sun. It is a reverential name for the sun god, evoking a sense of strength, power, and brilliance.
